stock-apparel-maker-contest.head: bb64b4092dfd3e74595dfa2ceb53f068f6986fee
stock-apparel-maker-contest.scope: The stock Compiler sees Apparel Crafting +50 when loaded, removes the same value when unloaded and consumes that stat for eyewear 671. PacketLog 170/649/1800/2176 attributes the adds and removals to 528. The eyewear timer remains at its 3 s floor with or without the specialization.

stats.source: GOB 528 grants Apparel Crafting 652 at one point per learned rank.
stats.runtime: CraftingHandler.Specialization maps the apparel item category to stat 652. OrdinaryItemCompile snapshots it separately from the two compile time reductions and passes it to the success contest.
stats.test: CraftSpecializationUsesTheLoadedSkillForTheShippedCategory verifies +50, excludes a consumable, and shows a success at the same roll only with Apparel Maker loaded. PR563 verifies the correct category and native modifier records. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/563

behavior-tests.source: The shipped while-enabled Apparel Crafting modifier is scoped to apparel rather than the general or consumable timing reductions.
behavior-tests.runtime: The loaded passive applies to the item's category, and unload removes it. It feeds the ordinary compile success check without altering the 3 s minimum.
behavior-tests.test: CraftSpecializationUsesTheLoadedSkillForTheShippedCategory compares loaded and unloaded state and a non-apparel item. The PR563 exact-stock fixture compiles eyewear at specialization 0 and 50, with the same minimum delay and one charge consumed in each case. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/563
